race.comment: SHELSTEIN (9) gets in well at the weights with the 2kg claim and will be high on confidence following that last-start Doomben victory. Will appreciate a couple of key scratchings here and can go back-to-back without surprising. FUKUBANA (1) has a handy record around this circuit with a win and two placings from four spins and will strip fitter second-up from the spell. Can feature with natural improvement. GORBACHEV (6) was a touch disappointing last time out but go on the solid win over this course and distance two back. Worth another chance. MISTER BIANCO (4) best of the rest. He has lost his way a bit but we know tha the talent is in there!
